verdict.rationale: Stripe documents dedicated Financial Connections webhooks for new linked accounts and for completed balance, ownership and transaction refreshes [docs-12, docs-13, docs-24, docs-25]. The same page points to a relink flow for inactive accounts, which implies connection-state events [docs-14]. That covers the core no-polling story, but a community report notes data is pulled only daily, which limits how current the data can be [comm-7]. Missing for 10: evidence that webhooks are signed or how to verify them, an explicit connection-state (inactive/disconnected) event, clarity on whether events carry the changed data or only a refresh-complete notice, and independent hands-on confirmation.
